scope.reason: Playtest feedback (2026-11-25): the gauntlet painting for Quenching Cold read as a plain hand icon. The cold debuff now wears a white snowflake on a blue ground, readable at a glance. It replaces that one painting from the 2026-11-19 batch, whose record stays as it was accepted then.

references.role: The live mechanic the icon stands for: where the raid applies heart_quench_cold.
The vector source, rasterized to the shipped 128px opaque WebP with sharp (resize 128, flatten, webp quality 88).

assets.prompt: A white six-armed snowflake with a soft pale-blue glow, centred on a blue radial ground inside a dark frame.
